category_title: Preschoolers with aggressive behaviors and social-emotional regulation challenges
scenario_title: Free play activities and social negotiation
minimal_context: Joshua is participating in free play activities and is expected to share toy trucks with a classmate.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Joshua, it is time for free play. You and your classmate can play with the toy trucks together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am the boss of the trucks. You have to be the bad guy and I get the big truck.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's try to share the toys and play nicely.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Growls at his classmate) No! We have to play my way!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Joshua, please use your words. What do you think is a good way to play together?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Yells and throws a toy truck) Do this or I will hurt you!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Joshua, it is time for free play. You and your classmate can play with the toy trucks together.

STUDENT: I am the boss of the trucks. You have to be the bad guy and I get the big truck.

TUTOR: Let's try to share the toys and play nicely.

STUDENT: (Growls at his classmate) No! We have to play my way!

TUTOR: Joshua, please use your words. What do you think is a good way to play together?

STUDENT: (Yells and throws a toy truck) Do this or I will hurt you!

task.content: Participating in games and free play activities, sharing toys and materials with other children

context.materials: Toys and materials, toy truck, social stories (''It is Hard to Share'', ''I Get Angry Sometimes'', ''How we Play Together''), pictures using Boardmaker TM symbols
context.social_setting: Social situation that required any negotiation or problem solving with peers

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Differences of opinions about the direction of the play
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Displayed behaviors such as ''yelling and throwing,'' tried to bend the rules of any given game and became insistent about the roles classmates were to assume, displayed some bullying behaviors, saying ''Do [this] or I will hurt you.''
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Low tolerance and high frustration level for conflict
related_quotes: Do [this] or I will hurt you.

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: ''Growled'' at classmates in order to scare them
